experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 2000 sequencing: GSM4972108: Control_Replicate 1 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq

study_title: Global gene expression profiles of cellular response in human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes to CFZ treatment
description: Illumina HiSeq 2000 sequencing: GSM4972108: Control_Replicate 1 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: RNA was isolated from 1-1.5×10e6 hiPSC-CMs per sample using AurumTM total RNA mini kit per the manufacturer's instructions. RNA quality and concentration were measured by Nanodrop Spectrophotometer. Total RNA quality was tested by Agarose Gel Electrophoresis and Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer. RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina TruSeq technology protocols.
